chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Evolves to Yellow Diamond Second Rank in Death World!
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, now a Yellow Diamond skeleton, teams up with an old ally to defeat the Broken Sword King and a hidden second-rank expert, then absorbs their fire seeds to ascend to Yellow Diamond second rank. A mysterious ally wielding the Seven Treasures Wonderful Tree turns the tide.
og_title: Yellow Diamond Ascension: Xiao Chen's Deadly Alliance and Victory
og_description: In the bleak Death World, Xiao Chen rises to Yellow Diamond second rank by defeating the Broken Sword King with the help of a mysterious ally wielding the Seven Treasures Wonderful Tree. Fire seeds and soul attacks collide in this chapter.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Reaches Yellow Diamond Second Rank!
twitter_description: Xiao Chen, as a Yellow Diamond skeleton, slays the Broken Sword King and an ally, absorbs their fire seeds, and ascends to Yellow Diamond second rank with the aid of the Seven Treasures Wonderful Tree.
